approval_evidence.quote: This new drug application provides for the use of Xtandi (enzalutamide) Capsules for the treatment of patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer who have previously received docetaxel. (FDA approval letter, NDA 203415, signed 08/31/2012)

series_start_reason: Astellas' financial-results library on astellas.com begins with Q1 FY2017 (April-June 2017). The FY2017 Q1 document also prints the prior-year quarter (64.2 billion JPY, April-June 2016) but the other FY2016 quarters are not printed individually in any document found, so no isolated 2016Q2 row is included. Launch (2012) to 2017Q1 is therefore not citable from Astellas documents located; searched legacy URL patterns returned 404.
notes: Printed line is the product's row in Astellas' 'Global' sales-of-major-products table (billions of JPY); the U.S., Japan, Established Markets, China and International Markets rows beneath are Astellas' own regional split and are not used. The separate 'XTANDI co-promotion fee in the United States' line is a different revenue item and is not used. Astellas fiscal year runs April-March; FY Q1 = April-June maps to calendar Q2.
search_log: read https://www.astellas.com/en/investors/financial-results-library (146 PDF links) and cached every financial-results PDF (main release, supplementary documents, presentation, earnings-call scripts); earliest linked quarter is Q1 FY2017 (April-June 2017)
guessed legacy astellas.com/en/ir/library/pdf/... URLs for FY2013-FY2016 documents: all returned 404, so no earlier Astellas document was found
extracted the 'Global' sales-of-major-products table in each quarter's supplementary document (billions of JPY, one decimal) with pdfplumber, the verifier's extractor

where the quarter's own document text layer splits the digits of the row, the same quarter was read from a later document of the same fiscal year, or derived from year-to-date figures (rows are labelled accordingly)
cross-check: for every complete fiscal year the four quarters were summed and compared with the full-year figure on the same table (differences at most 0.2 billion JPY from rounding)
